name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Pine Top
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals at the top of the hill
why_it_matters: The Karnataka State Tourism Development Corporation hotel at the summit of Nandi Hills — and one of only a couple of proper restaurants at the top of the hill. With an Indian restaurant, bar, sun terrace and garden, it is the dependable sit-down meal for the many visitors who come up for the famous Nandi Hills sunrise.
insider_tip: Dining options at the summit are very limited — this KSTDC restaurant is the main one, so plan around it or carry food. After a pre-dawn sunrise climb, a hot breakfast and filter coffee here is the move. Standard government-hotel hours.
signature_address: Nandi Hills summit, Nandi Hills, Chikkaballapura District, Karnataka 562103

name: Nandi Upachar
area: NH-44, Devanahalli–Nandi Hills crossing, base of Nandi Hills
why_it_matters: A large pure-veg multi-cuisine restaurant on NH-44 right at the Devanahalli–Nandi Hills crossing — the standard breakfast halt for visitors heading up to Nandi Hills, with Karnataka-style tiffin, clean washrooms and ample parking. It is built to turn around the steady stream of sunrise-bound travellers.
insider_tip: The natural stop for breakfast on the drive up — it is at the crossing where you turn for Nandi Hills, with both self-service and an AC hall. Karnataka-style dosas and idli are the order; clean toilets make it a practical pit stop.
signature_address: NH-44, Devanahalli–Nandi Hills crossing, near Nandi Hills, Chikkaballapura District, Karnataka 562110

name: NH7 Refuel
area: National Highway 7 (NH-44), before the Nandi Hills turn, Devanahalli
why_it_matters: A highway restaurant on NH-44 just before the left turn for Nandi Hills, a popular pit stop for travellers before or after the hill. It is known for wood-fired pizza alongside Punjabi North Indian food, with spacious seating and evening live music — the relaxed, multi-cuisine option at the base of the hill.
insider_tip: Good for a meal after coming down from the sunrise climb rather than the rushed dawn ascent. Wood-fired pizza is the house speciality; evenings have a live band. Easy roadside access on the highway, ample parking.
signature_address: National Highway 7 (NH-44), before the Nandi Hills turn, Devanahalli, Chikkaballapura District, Karnataka 562110

name: Empire Restaurant Devanahalli
area: BB Road, near Rani Circle, Devanahalli town
why_it_matters: A Devanahalli outlet of Empire, the long-running Bengaluru restaurant brand that traces its name to 1966 and is known across the region for fried chicken, biryani and late hours. On BB Road near Rani Circle, it is the dependable non-veg option in the town at the base of the Nandi Hills route, well rated across thousands of reviews.
insider_tip: The go-to for fried chicken and biryani when you want a non-veg meal off the hill. It is in Devanahalli town, a short drive from the Nandi Hills base — handy if you are also near the Bengaluru airport. Quick service, family-friendly.
signature_address: 975, 1st Floor, BB Road, near Rani Circle, Devanahalli, Chikkaballapura District, Karnataka 562110
